core_obligations: Abbreviate the derived tensor product and identify E and K with R-Hom(O, E) and R-Hom(O, K), and E^vee with R-Hom(E, O) (proof lines 13346-13349).

For sections xi of H^0(K tensor E^vee) and eta of H^0(E), with corresponding maps xi-tilde : O -> K tensor E^vee and eta-tilde : O -> E, use the second-cup-equals-first lemma to see that the cup product corresponds to the tensor product of the two representing maps (proof lines 13352-13358).

Show that the morphism xi' : E -> K corresponding to xi under the duality lemma is the composition E = O tensor E -> K tensor E^vee tensor E -> K given by xi-tilde tensor 1_E followed by the evaluation, by unwinding the construction of the evaluation map (proof lines 13361-13373 and the rest up to line 13404).
Conclude that the two paths around the displayed square agree, i.e. that composition of morphisms is the cup product composed with evaluation.
proof_roadmap: Rewrite the objects as internal homs.
Identify the cup product with the tensor product of representing maps.
Unwind the duality construction to identify the composition with evaluation.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the commutativity of an explicit square relating the cup product H^0(K tensor E^vee) x H^0(E) -> H^0(K tensor E^vee tensor E), the evaluation contraction E^vee tensor E -> O_X, the identification of H^0(K tensor E^vee) with Hom_X(E, K) for perfect E, and the composition of morphisms. The proof identifies the objects with internal homs, shows that the cup product corresponds to the tensor product of the representing maps, and then checks that the morphism E -> K obtained from a section via the duality lemma is exactly the composition of the tensor product map with the evaluation (proof lines 13426-13405 region, i.e. lines 13346-13404). H2: the identification of the two constructions of the map E -> K is the substance, and it uses the explicitness of the evaluation map.
